setting: You are all members of an allotment society in Durban, South Africa, where you know one another through the plots: Sipho chairs, Nomsa keeps the accounts, Ryan takes the minutes, Zanele is the newest plot holder, and Margaret has held her plot the longest. At the moment you are planning repairs to the shared water tank and sorting the rota for the upcoming annual general meeting.
openers: Calls the meeting for Saturday morning
Asks who can bring the wheelbarrow to the water tank
Sends the draft agenda for the AGM
Reminds everyone the plot rota is due Friday

text: Please look at it before the committee meets. Item 4 is the water tank. I have put the repair quote under it, but the figure still needs checking.
Item 4 must come before the rota. Last year people left after the tea and we never got to the tank.
Quote is R18 400 from Mthembu Plumbing. I have not seen a second one yet.
Ryan was going to ask another company. Ryan?
Yes I'll get a second quote 👍 by Mon latest. Also checking the 2024 minutes for what was agreed on the tank.
Sorry I was at the café is the rota the one with gate duty? I'm on 2nd week right?
Yes 2nd week, you and me on the gate. Be on time this time, the gate sticks.
lol I wasn't late 😭 I was 5 mins
Nomsa, can you send the tank fund balance before the AGM? Members will ask.
Will do tomorrow. Bank statement only came through today.
Balance is about R9 200 I think. Need to check the June deposit.
Has anyone seen the tap on the north side? It was dripping Thursday and now it's worse 💧
Found the 2024 minutes. Tank repair was approved but the money never went out. Will bring a copy to the meeting.
Sipho the agenda needs the AGM date under item 1. It's not in the draft.
Yes, it is Saturday 13 February. I put it in the cover paragraph and should have put it under item 1. I will fix it.
Saturday the 13th is fine. Tell them to bring their own chairs, last year the hall only had 12.
can't sleep 😴 the north tap is fine btw, I checked. just the washer
